user.title: Add a window
user.description: Name this window. You can set the cover and the direction it faces next.

init.title: Adaptive Cover
init.description: Pick the cover and the direction the window faces. Everything else has a sensible default.

data_description.covers: The cover(s) this window controls. Multiple covers move together.
data_description.facing: Pick the nearest compass point, or choose Custom to type the azimuth.
data_description.azimuth: Which way the glass faces (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W). An approximation is fine.

data_description.window_height: Roughly how high the top of the glass is above the floor. Eyeball it.
data_description.glare_distance: How far across the floor direct sun may reach before shading. Smaller = darker/cooler; larger = more sun and view.

data_description.fov_left: Degrees to the left of centre the window still sees the sun.
data_description.fov_right: Degrees to the right of centre the window still sees the sun.
data_description.min_elevation: Ignore the sun below this elevation.
data_description.position_after_sunset: Where to leave the cover once the sun is down.

data_description.brightness_sensor: Optional outdoor light/irradiance sensor (lux or W/m²). Preferred over cloud cover.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional; its cloud-cover % is used only when no brightness sensor is set.
data_description.shade_above: Shade when clearness rises to/above this (sensor's own scale, or clearness%=100-cloud).
data_description.open_below: Open back up below this. Keep it under 'shade above' — the gap is an anti-flap dead-band.
data_description.indoor_lux_sensor: Optional room sensor used as a gentle comfort governor. Empty = disabled.
data_description.indoor_lux_cap: Room brightness above which to trim more closed (0 = off).

data_description.interval: How often to recompute and (if enabled) move.
data_description.quantize_step: Snap target positions to this step.
data_description.min_delta: Don't move for changes smaller than this.

data_description.manual_tolerance: How far a settled cover may differ from our last command before it counts as a manual move.
data_description.manual_timeout: Resume automatic control this long after a manual move (also resets at sunrise).

reset_manual_control.name: Reset manual control
reset_manual_control.description: Resume automatic control for a window's covers.

no_set_position.title: Cover does not support set position
no_set_position.description: The cover {cover} cannot be set to a specific position, so Adaptive Cover can't drive it. Open/close-only covers are planned for a later release.
